changes.description: Actual handlers, associated imports, RefreshRequest and function reexports gated by uar-driver. Enabled handler signatures/bodies and registered routing/auth checks retained. Disabled router registration unchanged.
OpenAPI annotations moved to unconditional hidden-public schema functions; existing __path descriptor names reexported. No runtime route is registered to these empty documentation functions.

Feature-specific observer field declarations keep enabled names and use underscore storage with explicit serde rename when not both surreal-backend and uar-driver. Same typed JSON extraction in both profiles. Surreal capability branch now returns its existing tail expression.
Equivalent None-or-below-threshold predicates preserve Owner/Admin rejection truth tables.
Command and args grouped into SidecarCommand; existing upsert body destructures the borrowed fields. One production caller and two existing test callers updated; all existing assertions retained.
Private parse_task_ref error boxed and moved out at its two callers; response codes, IDs, error messages and control flow unchanged.

publicRustImpact: upsert_sidecar_in_vec signature now takes SidecarCommand instead of separate command and args arguments; external Rust callers must adapt. HTTP and persisted sidecar shapes are unchanged.
New hidden-public schema module exposes documentation functions and generated descriptors so they remain reachable without runtime feature; these are not route handlers.
Private parse_task_ref Box error is internal only.
Enabled UAR handler and request Rust signatures are unchanged; unavailable runtime handler symbols are now omitted consistently with existing disabled routing.
